text:
marina: Heads-up — after yesterday's kernel selector change I see Mixtral MoE serving p99 jump on a subset of routes. profiler trace attached (excerpt):
marina: 
```
router.forward: 12.4ms -> 43.8ms (hot path)
kv_cache.lookup: 0.6ms -> 9.2ms (miss storms)
expert.exec: 8.1ms -> 9.0ms (minor)
end-to-end p50 38ms -> 45ms, p99 210ms -> 330ms
```
marina: This looks like softmax logits scaling + new kernel picking causing expert handshake storms and KV eviction chatter.
eli: ugh, saw similar in nightly canary logs. any reproducible script?
jasmine: I've got a reproducer — 6-token prompts with high router entropy trigger it. Posting test harness: 
```
# repro outline
for i in range(2000):
  send_request(model="mixtral-xxl", prompt=rand_entropy_prompt(), top_k=2)
```
ryan: curious — is batcher changing batching window based on kernel? I thought selector should be orthogonal from batching heuristics.
marina: the selector chooses a fused kernel when sequence_len<=64; that fused path disables our soft KV prefetch and changes enqueue order so batching becomes burstier. combined with softmax temp tweak in router -> more top-k ties -> more frequent rehandshakes.
eli: can you grep for "handshake" in router logs?
perf-bot: Found 342 handshake events in last 30m on cluster svc-mix-3 (baseline 27). sample log: `router: handshake start req_id=... experts=[12,7] top_k=2 temp=0.9`
jasmine: experiment idea: pin kernel to legacy fused=false on canary and set router.temp=0.8 to reduce tie-breaking. Also increase per-expert queue depth from 16->32 to absorb bursts.
marina: ran a quick canary with fused=false + queue=32 for 15m: p99 dropped from 330ms->290ms, handshake count -60%. still above baseline.
ryan: maybe KV cache eviction threshold needs tune. Miss storms show tiny hot prefixes getting evicted because fused kernel uses LRU buckets differently. tweak suggestion: bump kv.cache.prefetch_window from 64->96 and kv.cache.hot_threshold from 128->192.
eli: I'll run a microbenchmark for prefetch window impact. posting a small script to run on same machine: 
```
# kv microbench
for w in [64,80,96,128]:
  set_config(kv_cache.prefetch_window=w)
  run_rps_test(800qps, duration=120s)
```
marina: also observed more cross-device memcopy churn when fused kernel chosen — likely due to expert parallelism layout (shard packing). we may need kernel to respect current expert-shard affinity.
jasmine: what about increasing top_k from 2->3 for high-entropy prompts? fewer ties but more expert load. tradeoff?
perf-bot: Quick sim: top_k=3 increases avg tokens/sec cost ~+18% but reduces handshake variance by ~30% in the sim workload.
ryan: tradeoff seems acceptable for customer routes where p99 SLO > 200ms. we should make this a per-route override in router policy.
eli: filed a small RFC: `moe-router/policy/route_overrides` to allow per-route {top_k, temp, queue_depth, kernel_preference}.
marina: actionable plan:
- roll back kernel selector on canary (fused=false) and monitor 2h (eli)
- run kv prefetch sweep (eli)
- add per-route top_k override for problem route (ryan)
- instrument handshake metric with expert list + kernel flag (jasmine)
ryan: I'll pick up the per-route override: quick patch to router config -> will canary tomorrow.
jasmine: added metric instrument PR, will wire into console dashboard.
marina: if rollback fixes p99 we can reintroduce kernel change but with an opt-in kernel hint and linker to expert affinity.
eli: running microbench now, will post numbers in 30m.
perf-bot: baseline snapshot uploaded to /s3/perf-snapshots/mixtral/1799934567/baseline.json
marina: thanks all. Also note: update rollout notes so infra knows to expect handshake surge when toggling kernel selectors. adding a short blurb in the canary PR. :memo: :thumbsup:
ryan: assigning follow-ups in the ticket. ping me if you need infra quota to increase expert queue sizes.
marina: closing for now, will re-open thread if numbers diverge.
